+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("DNS lookup failed for redirect: %w", err)
+			}
+			for _, ip := range redirectIPs {
+				if isPrivateIP(ip) {
+					return fmt.Errorf("redirect to private IP not allowed")
+				}
+			}
+			if len(via) >= 5 {
+				return fmt.Errorf("too many redirects")
+			}
+			return nil
+		},
+	}
+
+	req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, targetURL, nil)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "URLPreview/1.0")
+
+	return client.Do(req)
+}
+
+func extractMeta(body io.Reader) (title, description string) {
+	tokenizer := html.NewTokenizer(body)
+	for {
+		tt := tokenizer.Next()
+		switch tt {
+		case html.ErrorToken:
+			return title, description
+		case html.StartTagToken, html.SelfClosingTagToken:
+			t := tokenizer.Token()
+			if t.Data == "title" && tt == html.StartTagToken && title == "" {
+				if tokenizer.Next() == html.TextToken {
+					title = strings.TrimSpace(tokenizer.Token().Data)
+				}
+			}
+			if t.Data == "meta" {
+				var name, content string
+				for _, attr := range t.Attr {
+					if strings.EqualFold(attr.Key, "name") {
+						name = strings.ToLower(attr.Val)
+					}
+					if strings.EqualFold(attr.Key, "content") {
+						content = attr.Val
+					}
+				}
+				if name == "description" && description == "" {
+					description = content
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func FetchURLPreview(ctx echo.Context) error {
+	var req previewRequest
+	if err := ctx.Bind(&req); err != nil {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid request body"})
+	}
+
+	if req.URL == "" {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "url is required"})
+	}
+
+	resp, err := safeHTTPGet(req.URL)
+	if err != nil {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+
+	limitedReader := io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20) // 1MB limit
+	title, description := extractMeta(limitedReader)
+
+	return ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, previewResponse{
+		Title:       title,
+		Description: description,
+	})
+}
+
+func main() {
+	e := echo.New()
+	e.POST("/preview", FetchURLPreview)
+	e.Logger.Fatal(e.Start(":8080"))
+}

+				if isPrivateIP(ip) {
+					return fmt.Errorf("redirect to internal address is not allowed")
+				}
+			}
+			return nil
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+func parseMeta(body io.Reader) (title string, description string) {
+	tokenizer := html.NewTokenizer(body)
+	for {
+		tt := tokenizer.Next()
+		switch tt {
+		case html.ErrorToken:
+			return title, description
+		case html.StartTagToken, html.SelfClosingTagToken:
+			t := tokenizer.Token()
+			if t.Data == "title" && title == "" {
+				if tokenizer.Next() == html.TextToken {
+					title = strings.TrimSpace(tokenizer.Token().Data)
+				}
+			}
+			if t.Data == "meta" {
+				var name, content string
+				for _, attr := range t.Attr {
+					switch strings.ToLower(attr.Key) {
+					case "name":
+						name = strings.ToLower(attr.Val)
+					case "content":
+						content = attr.Val
+					}
+				}
+				if name == "description" && description == "" {
+					description = content
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func FetchURLPreview(ctx echo.Context) error {
+	var req PreviewRequest
+	if err := ctx.Bind(&req); err != nil {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid request body"})
+	}
+	if req.URL == "" {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "url is required"})
+	}
+
+	u, err := validateURL(req.URL)
+	if err != nil {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": err.Error()})
+	}
+
+	client := newSafeHTTPClient()
+	resp, err := client.Get(u.String())
+	if err != nil {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadGateway, map[string]string{"error": "failed to fetch URL"})
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+
+	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return ctx.JSON(http.StatusBadGateway, map[string]string{"error": "URL returned non-200 status"})
+	}
+
+	limitedReader := io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20) // 1 MB limit
+	title, description := parseMeta(limitedReader)
+
+	return ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, PreviewResponse{
+		Title:       title,
+		Description: description,
+	})
+}
+
+func main() {
+	e := echo.New()
+	e.POST("/preview", FetchURLPreview)
+	e.Logger.Fatal(e.Start(":8080"))
+}

+		CheckRedirect: func(r *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
